combo.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that does not have summoning sickness.
combo.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling all but the bottom six cards of each library face down.
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each player to mill ten cards, thus milling the remainder of each player's library.
When your opponents go to draw a card during their next draw steps, they will lose the game due to attempting to draw from an empty library.

combo.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
combo.description:

Starscape Cleric triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers for each opponent that lost life.
Resolve a Exquisite Blood trigger, gaining 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Otherwise, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 2 or 3 two additional times.

combo.notablePrerequisites:

combo.description:
Cast Buried Alive by paying {2} and two life, searching for Chainer, Viscera Seer, and Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
Cast Reanimate by paying 2 life.
returning Chainer onto the battlefield and causing you to lose five life.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Viscera Seer from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Activate Chainer by paying nine life, returning Gray Merchant of Asphodel from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life lost this way.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gray Merchant of Asphodel, scrying 1.
